components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--paper); } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 54px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 19px/1.3 'Golos Text', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav .ds-active { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav .ds-active::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--ink); content: ''; }

components.css: .ds-photo { display: flex; aspect-ratio: 1.08; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--photo); color: var(--muted); text-align: center; font: 400 14px/1.2 'Golos Text', sans-serif; } .ds-photo svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Portion Comparison
components.description: Two portion and price pairs aligned as one dish comparison.
components.css: .ds-portions { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font: 400 19px/1.35 'Golos Text', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-portions > div { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding-block: 4px; } .ds-portions > div + div { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-portions dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Phone Action
components.description: Persistent graphite phone link for the confirmed delivery number.
components.css: .ds-call { display: flex; min-height: 54px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--action); color: #fff; font: 600 20px/1.1 'Golos Text', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-call:hover { background: var(--ink); } .ds-call:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: This design system applies to the delivery menu surface only. It presents each dish as one calm comparison unit: a labelled photo well, a name, and aligned portion prices. The banquet homepage keeps its existing visual system.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet monochrome colors with one graphite action surface.
Open comparison rows with thin dividers, not card shells.
One humanist sans-serif family with tabular numeric alignment.
An individual neutral photo placeholder for every dish until real photography arrives.

rules.name: The Honest Image Rule
rules.body: Use only a real photo belonging to that dish; otherwise keep its own labelled neutral photo well.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Golos Text throughout and build hierarchy with size, weight, and alignment.

dos: Keep each dish name next to its portion and price comparison.
Preserve confirmed content and the phone and PDF paths.
donts: Do not generate or reuse food photos across dishes.
Do not add newspaper columns, gradients, ornaments, or unverified menu claims.
